answer_1.quote: We propose the novel task of CQA summarization, which takes QA pairs about a single entity as input and make a summary written in declarative sentences (Section 2).
answer_1.outputs: concise declarative summary of the entity

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use ROUGE (F1) and BERTScore (F1) with the default configuration.

answer_4.quote: We further conducted human evaluation to judge the quality of generated summaries by different models. For every entity in the test set, we showed summaries generated by four models ... to three human judges to choose the best and worst summaries for three criteria: informativeness (Inf.), coherence (Coh.), and conciseness (Con.).
answer_4.guideline: Human judges were asked to select the best and worst summaries for each of the three criteria: informativeness, coherence, and conciseness.
